title: helm(private): stabilize values schema + templating for init hooks and upgrade/rollback
author: Evelyn Chen
description: Motivation: Private deployments have seen several upgrade/rollback failures across Helm releases when values templating and init hook ordering changed between chart versions. This PR refactors the values schema, improves templating determinism for init jobs/hooks, and tightens upgrade/rollback validations to avoid accidental data-plane downtime. Summary of changes: 1) values.schema.json: canonicalize the private.values schema (kms, nodeSelector, tolerations, initJobs, storage) and add stricter migrating deprecation keys so older installs get a clear migration path. 2) templates/init-job.yaml + templates/hooks/*: reorder hooks and make init job idempotent (guard with annotations and createdBy checks), add readiness probe loop for post-migration migrations. 3) helpers/_templating.tpl: centralize common templating helpers to avoid duplication and subtle rendering differences between Helm 3.7/3.10. 4) upgrade-rollback: add pre-upgrade validation hook that compares effective values.schema and disallows incompatible changes unless --force-migrate is provided; add post-rollback cleanup hook to remove orphaned init-job artifacts. 5) tests: unit tests for values schema validation, and an integration K8s job harness that simulates a rolling upgrade with mock PVs. Backwards compatibility: schema changes are additive for most top-level keys. Where breaking changes were necessary (deprecated encryptionKey -> kms.keyName), a migration path and automatic compatibility shim are provided. Checklist: - [x] values schema refactor and docs updated - [x] templating helpers consolidated - [x] init job idempotency + hooks ordering fixed - [x] pre-upgrade validation hook implemented - [x] integration tests for upgrade/rollback - [x] release notes drafted Related: Linear ENG-4721, ENG-4835. See runbook link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4721/helm-private-upgrade-rollbacks (internal).
commits: refactor(values): normalize private values.schema.json and add deprecation mappings
feat(helm): centralize templating helpers and switch to deterministic sprig usage
fix(init): make init-job idempotent and add createdBy annotation guards
feat(upgrade): pre-upgrade validation hook to detect incompatible value changes
chore(tests): add unit tests for values schema and integration job harness
docs: update chart/README with migration steps and examples
review_comments: Samir Rao: please add a short-circuit flag to the pre-upgrade hook so operators can opt-out during emergency maintenance. (addressed in commit 4)
Lina Martinez: tests look good, can you add a note about Helm 3.7 vs 3.10 rendering implications in the README? (added)
Jordan Kim: observed one flake in the integration harness where the mock PV detach took longer; added retry and backoff (fixed)
Evelyn Chen: replied with test run artifacts and clarified the migration shim behavior for deprecated keys
release_notes: Stabilize Redwood Private Helm chart upgrade/rollback: tightened values schema, deterministic templating helpers, idempotent init jobs, pre-upgrade validation and post-rollback cleanup hooks. Migration shim provided for deprecated encryptionKey->kms.keyName. Operators should run the provided migration job or supply --force-migrate to enable automatic migration.
